response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), m AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS av FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(t.total - m.av) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM t CROSS JOIN m WHERE t.total > m.av

assumptions.assumption: The 'average total' is the mean of per-player totals across all players who pass the death-country filter and have at least one appearance row with both g_1b and g_cf non-null. Players with no usable rows are excluded.
A blank death country means an empty string or whitespace only, so it is excluded along with NULL.
The second output value is the mean of (total - average total) over only the players whose total is above the average.
